snippet.title: 007 First Light: Exclusive behind the scenes developer interview - PC Gaming Show 2025
snippet.description:
We took our team of secret agents on a daring mission: Find out all we can about IO Interactive's upcoming game 007 First Light.

Get ready for familiar faces, exotic locations, and, of course, gadgets, as you embark on this new Bond experience.

Start your own journey by wishlisting the game below:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3768760/007_First_Light/
